PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Registered adult nurse with six years' experience in adult intensive care, including three and a half
years as a Band 6 Senior Staff Nurse on a 24-bed mixed ICU/HDU. Confident caring for level 2 and level 3
patients, including ventilated, proned and haemofiltered patients, and regularly coordinating the unit
on day and night shifts. Holds the post-registration Critical Care Nursing qualification and Advanced
Life Support. NMC practice assessor and supervisor who enjoys supporting students and newly qualified
nurses. British citizen with full right to work in the UK. Looking for a Band 6 critical care role in
Greater Manchester.

CLINICAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Staff Nurse (Band 6) - Adult Critical Care Unit
Irwell Valley Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust, Manchester            March 2023 - Present
- Shift coordinator for a 24-bed mixed ICU/HDU (around 60% of shifts), allocating staff,
  managing admissions and discharges and liaising with outreach, bed managers and consultants.
- Care of level 3 patients: invasive ventilation, tracheostomy care and weaning, arterial and
  central lines, vasoactive infusions, sedation holds and delirium screening (CAM-ICU).
- Link nurse for continuous renal replacement therapy (CRRT): runs bedside teaching and keeps
  the competency log for 40+ staff.
- Intra- and inter-hospital transfers of ventilated patients with the transfer team.
- Practice assessor and practice supervisor (NMC SSSA) for student nurses and Band 5 preceptees.
- Led a pressure ulcer prevention audit that cut unit-acquired category 2+ ulcers by about a third
  over 12 months.
- Contributes to ICU follow-up clinic and relatives' support sessions.

Staff Nurse (Band 5) - General Intensive Care Unit
Northern Moors NHS Foundation Trust, Bolton                        September 2020 - February 2023
- Completed a 12-month critical care preceptorship and step 1-2 of the national critical care
  competency framework.
- Cared for level 2 and 3 patients during the COVID-19 surges, including proning, high-flow
  oxygen and NIV/CPAP.
- Administered IV medicines, blood products and TPN; venepuncture and cannulation.
- Escalated deteriorating patients using NEWS2 and the sepsis pathway; supported the critical
  care outreach team on ward reviews.
- Member of the unit infection prevention group (VAP and line-infection bundles).

Student Nurse placements (2017 - 2020)
Acute medical unit, emergency department, surgical ward, district nursing, intensive care.
